messages:
Alex Chen: Hey team — first day. Trying to use kubectl but getting: 'Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden: User "system:anonymous" ...'. I think my kubeconfig isn't set. How do I get cluster access (dev cluster) and the right namespace? Who approves CSRs?

Olivia Park: Welcome Alex! :wave: For most new hires we use the Access Portal (https://idp.redwood.com) to provision kubeconfig. If you signed up there, did you request 'dev-cluster' access? If not, open the portal and request "dev-cluster:dev-ns" role. That auto-starts provisioning.

Alex Chen: I don't see dev-cluster in the portal. I tried the CSR command from the onboarding doc but got stuck creating the manifest. What's the exact command to generate a CSR I should send?

Matt S: Hi Alex — we can do it manually. Quick option: run:

openssl genrsa -out /tmp/alex.key 2048
openssl req -new -key /tmp/alex.key -subj "/CN=alex/O=dev" -out /tmp/alex.csr
cat /tmp/alex.csr | base64 | tr -d '\n' > /tmp/alex.csr.b64

Then paste the base64 into this CSR template and kubectl apply -f csr.yaml. I'll approve it from my side.

Alex Chen: Thanks. Pasting the manifest now. Any RBAC steps after approval to get me into the 'dev' namespace?

Olivia Park: After Matt approves, you'll get a client cert. Then we typically create a RoleBinding in the dev namespace. You can request dev-ns edit access. Example we use:

kind: RoleBinding
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: alex-dev-edit
  namespace: dev
subjects:
- kind: User
  name: alex
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: edit
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

I'll file the RoleBinding once you confirm the username in the cert.

Matt S: Approved the CSR (alex-csr). Generating kubeconfig and pushing to the Access Portal now. You should get an email with a download link in ~5 min.

permissions-bot: User group membership updated: alex added to 'dev-team' (role: edit) :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: Got the email and kubeconfig. kubectl get pods -n dev works now. Thanks everyone! :tada:

Olivia Park: Great — ping if you need port-forwarding or image-pull secrets set up. Also check the onboarding README in /docs/onboarding/k8s.

Alex Chen: Will do. One more Q — who do I ask for access to staging? Not needed today but want to know.

Matt S: For staging, open a ticket in #eng-infra with the staging access tag and copy me. Staging approvals need security review so expect ~24h.

Alex Chen: Noted, thanks again!
